Phase E completed: alps-analyze.md now emits a deterministic `json handover` fenced block (descriptor_id, alps_id_resolved, alps_found, descriptor_type, be_pattern, be_reference_demo, be_classes, semantic_classes, reasons, bear, notes). Pure-Semantic / container skip judgment now keys off `bear.skip` and `descriptor_type` instead of a fragile "all N/A" string match.
LoginHistory, Template, TradeLaw are intentional data composition elements (no detail page exists in EC-CUBE 4.3).
